text: Fruit is judged ready to harvest by external ripeness cues — netting/skin pattern development and stem colour/firmness at the point where the fruit attaches to the vine — rather than by a fixed day-count alone, though the crop cycle runs roughly 65-70 days from transplant to first harvest.
caveat: Exact day-count and post-harvest handling detail were not fully legible; treat the 65-70 day figure as approximate.
